description: This file defines functions and types for parsing and handling semantic version ranges, including wildcards, comparators, and logical combinations (AND/OR). It is part of a semantic versioning library.

methods.name: wildcardTypefromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to a corresponding wildcardType constant.

methods.name: rangeFunc
methods.description: Creates a Range function from a versionRange.

methods.name: OR
methods.description: Combines two Ranges with logical OR.

methods.name: AND
methods.description: Combines two Ranges with logical AND.

methods.name: ParseRange
methods.description: Parses a version range string into a Range function, supporting logical AND/OR and wildcards.

methods.name: splitORParts
methods.description: Splits range parts by '||' for OR logic.

methods.name: buildVersionRange
methods.description: Builds a versionRange object from comparator and version strings.

methods.name: splitAndTrim
methods.description: Splits a range string by spaces and trims whitespace.

methods.name: splitComparatorVersion
methods.description: Splits a string into comparator and version parts.

methods.name: getWildcardType
methods.description: Determines the wildcard type in a version string.

methods.name: createVersionFromWildcard
methods.description: Converts wildcard versions with 'x' into explicit versions with '0'.

methods.name: expandWildcardVersion
methods.description: Expands wildcard versions into explicit version ranges.

methods.name: parseComparator
methods.description: Parses a comparator string into a comparator function.

methods.name: MustParseRange
methods.description: Parses a range string and panics if invalid.
